config.name: Black Bag Limit Exemption
config.description: Residents of Swansea who recycle all accepted kerbside materials but still produce more than three black bags of non-recyclable waste can apply for an exemption to dispose of additional bags. The exemption is granted for specific non-recyclable waste types such as pet litter, bedding, and disposable nappies, and is valid for one year.
config.decision_tree_md:
```
START
│
├─ Is applicant recycling all accepted kerbside materials?
│   ├─ NO → REFUSE (Non-compliance with recycling) / REQUEST evidence
│   └─ YES ↓
│
├─ Does applicant produce more than three black bags of non-recyclable waste?
│   ├─ NO → REFUSE (Insufficient waste volume)
│   └─ YES ↓
│
├─ Is there any recyclable material in black or exemption bags?
│   ├─ YES → REFUSE (Recyclable material found)
│   └─ NO ↓
│
└─ APPROVE
    Outcome: Exemption granted for one year
    Conditions: Subject to random waste monitoring
```

config.correspondence_templates_md:
## Application Submission
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

Thank you for submitting your application for a Black Bag Limit Exemption. We have received your application and it is currently under review. You will be notified of the outcome within 14 days.

## Evidence Request
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We are currently reviewing your application for a Black Bag Limit Exemption. To proceed, we require proof of your recycling compliance. Please submit the necessary evidence within 7 days.

## Approval Notification
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We are pleased to inform you that your application for a Black Bag Limit Exemption has been approved. This exemption is valid for one year, subject to random waste monitoring.

## Refusal Notification
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We regret to inform you that your application for a Black Bag Limit Exemption has been refused due to non-compliance with the recycling requirements. Please ensure all recyclable materials are properly sorted in future applications.
